narrative:
## Handover Summary — Cost of Care

Claims, workforce, supplies and commission drivers validated against the revenue plan. Cost of care ratio held at 74.1% against a 74% target.

## Key Decisions
• Digital-first therapy pathway for Individual PMI mental-health referrals (−4% claims cost on the pathway)
• 120 agency carer roles converted to permanent in North and Midlands care homes
• Procurement saving on medical consumables phased from Q1

## Recommendation for Workforce Planning
Phase nurse, carer and dental nurse hiring ahead of winter so permanent staff replace agency shifts before the occupancy peak.
